definitions.explanation: In soccer, a defender who plays in the middle of the defensive line, in front of the goalkeeper, and is responsible for marking opposing forwards.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧センターバックだ。
センターバック⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: The center back stopped the opponent's attack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧センターバック⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Tall players are said to be well suited to playing center back.

notes:
From English 'center back'. The central defender(s) in a soccer team's back line, positioned in front of the goalkeeper.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- センターバック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to play center back
- ⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要|かなめ}→要：19357_kaname⟧: linchpin of the defense (a common description of the role)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サイドバック→サイドバック：30059_saidobakku⟧: fullback — a defender on the flank
- ⟦ボランチ→ボランチ：30060_boranchi⟧: defensive midfielder — plays just ahead of the defenders
